name: Stage 22: Hagtorp, väg 53 to Hälleforsnäs
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 22, Hagtorp, väg 53 to Hälleforsnäs.
utilities: Official area: Eskilstunas kommun, Flens kommun, Hälleforsnäs.

Hällaren and Bruksdammen are the main shelter/rest nodes. Hällaren has a first-come shelter, reported fireplace/grill, dry-toilet context and unsampled lake/swim context; Bruksdammen has shelter, grill/fireplace, fishing pier and accessible toilet on the island.

The Hagtorp/road 53 start has weak public transport and no Rosmossen reserve parking. Bäckåsen bus stop is the practical nearby access, roughly 1 km away, but service can be weekday/school-day limited; check live Sörmlandstrafiken.

Stage 22 ends at the Bruksdammen/Hälleforsnäs stage junction, not at Hälleforsnäs station. Station and town services are reached via the 22:1 connector/Bruksslingan access: bus/train, Coop/groceries, restaurants/cafes and Bäckstugan B&B. Accessibility claims belong to Bruksslingan/Bruksdammen boardwalks, not the full Stage 22.
waterSources: The official on-stage refill is the cold spring south of Holmsjön/Hellmanstorp; treat/filter and remember Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability.
Hällaren, Bruksdammen, Holmsjön and other lakes/wetlands are natural surface water only. Filter/boil/treat if used.
Hälleforsnäs town services can provide reliable water after the walkout via 22:1, subject to opening hours.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 16.5 km; Naturkartan also lists 16.5 km and its current API geometry measures about 15.93 km, OSM relation 3854542 computes about 16.305 km but is tagged 16 km, Äventyrligare lists about 16.29 km, and local official-GPX geometry is about 15.813 km. Use 16.5 km as canonical.

Use the local official-GPX node for route-builder snapping: Stage 21 meets Stage 22 at 59.197177479,16.617192612, and Stage 22 meets Stage 23, 22:1 and 23:2 at the Bruksdammen junction near 59.157932680,16.468506047. Official, Naturkartan and OSM endpoint coordinates are nearby aliases, not separate trailheads.

Naturkartan topology is clean for Stage 22: Stage 21 site 85954 ends exactly at Stage 22 start 59.197098814,16.616318951, and Stage 22 site 85955 ends exactly at Stage 23:2 start 59.158013456,16.468586290. Stage 23 Naturkartan geometry is reversed relative its title, so orient by intended stage direction when ingesting.

OSM relation 3854542 is connected but raw member order is misordered and has multi-kilometre jumps. Recommended Hagtorp-to-Hälleforsnäs way order is 290137355 reversed, 290137353 forward, 290137346 reversed, 290137329 forward, 290137331 reversed, 290137308 forward, 290137328 forward, 290137334 reversed, 290137316 forward, 1001819926 forward, 1001819925 forward, 290137313 forward, 290137352 forward, 290137354 forward, and 246698674 reversed.
Rundslinga 22.2 through Rosmossen is currently closed for safety because bark-beetle-damaged spruce can fall. Do not present that side loop as open, but the main stage is still described as passable.

Official 2026-04-22 warning: planned nature-conservation burning in Stora Fjällsjön reserve during suitable conditions in weeks 18-44 may cause strong smoke on burn day and for days after, and temporary staff-controlled passage along about 200 m of gravel-road trail. Staff on site can temporarily stop passage.

Recent official/user reports mention wind-thrown trees south of Gårmossen and trees over a boardwalk near Holmsjön, including an October 2025 report after earlier 2024 clearing. Avoid dead-spruce areas in strong wind or heavy rain.

Rosmossen, Holmsjöberg and Stora Fjällsjön reserve rules protect living/dead trees, plants, fungi/lichens and wildlife; organized camps or competitions need Länsstyrelsen permission. Do not mark any reserve service facilities inside Stora Fjällsjön.

No formal campsite was verified on the stage, and reports describe poor tent ground at Hällaren, tiny/limited tent options near Stora Gyringen, and unsafe/poor tent ground near Pilati sjö because of dead or broken trees. Single-night tenting may fall under allemansrätten outside sensitive/reserve restrictions, but avoid wet ground, private zones, dead-tree areas and reserve-rule conflicts.

Dogs should be kept tightly controlled, especially March 1-August 20, near grazing animals, wetlands and reserves. Autumn/winter hunting may occur; heed signs, wear visible colours and keep dogs controlled.

facilities.name: Hagtorp / road 53 stage start
facilities.description: Official stage-22 start. Direct services are weak and no Rosmossen reserve parking is available; plan access via nearby Bäckåsen or through-hike from stage 21, and stay clear of road traffic while waiting.

facilities.name: Bäckåsen bus access
facilities.description: Practical nearby bus option roughly 1 km from the Hagtorp/road 53 start; one OSM stop side has shelter context. Service can be weekday/school-day limited or disruption-dependent, so verify live Sörmlandstrafiken departures day-of.

facilities.name: Sagostigen seasonal cafe/toilets/parking detour
facilities.description: Seasonal paid attraction near the Hagtorp start, off the main stage. For 2026 it lists opening May 14-August 23 plus August 29-30, with cafe generally 10-16 in season and paid-entry toilet/parking context. Treat as a deliberate detour only.

facilities.name: Rosmossen loop closure
facilities.description: Rundslinga 22.2/Rosmossen is closed for safety due severe spruce-bark-beetle damage and falling-tree risk. This is a side-loop closure only; the Stage 22 mainline remains separately described as passable.

facilities.name: Stage 22 dog and hunting-season awareness
facilities.description: Keep dogs tightly controlled, especially March 1-August 20 and near grazing animals, wetlands and reserves. Autumn/winter hunting may occur; heed signs, wear visible colours and do not disturb active hunting.

facilities.name: Hällaren shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter after roughly 4 km. Free/shared first-come shelter; no booking and no rubbish bins. Hiker reports describe it as dry, well-kept and popular; store food defensively because mice have been reported, and do not assume tentable ground nearby.

facilities.name: Hällaren fireplace/grill
facilities.description: Reported established fireplace/grill at the shelter. Use only when fire rules allow, do not collect reserve wood, and do not rely on firewood being present.

facilities.name: Hällaren dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet reported behind/up in the woods from the shelter, including a 2024 report of a double dry toilet. Verify current condition on site.

facilities.name: Hällaren swimming/lake-water context
facilities.description: Informal swimming/lake-water context; official text says suitable swimming is toward the lake's south end, while the shelter is farther along the west shore. This is not a municipal sampled bathing place and has no lifeguard; lake water only, filter/boil/treat if used.

facilities.name: Hällaren approach navigation caveat
facilities.description: Hiker reports warn that some maps may tempt you along the lake shore; follow orange markings and leave the gravel road near the house/grass field roughly 400 m before the shelter.

facilities.name: Stora Gyringen rest area
facilities.description: Official/municipal text identifies Stora Gyringen as a good rest spot along Stage 22. This is a lake/rest context, not a shelter, toilet, or drinking-water point; hiker reports describe tiny/limited tent possibilities and wet bog vegetation nearby.

facilities.name: Gårmossen/Holmsjön windfall warning
facilities.description: October 2025 official-page comment reported several wind-thrown trees south of Gårmossen and trees over boardwalk nearer Holmsjön, despite earlier 2024 clearing reports. Approximate hazard band toward the spring; avoid dead-spruce areas in strong wind/heavy rain.

facilities.name: Stage 22 wet bog and boardwalk footing
facilities.description: After rain, hiker reports describe soaked vegetation, wet/slippery boardwalks, boggy areas and thigh-high shrubs around Gyringen/Holmsjön. Expect wet boots and slower progress in poor weather.

facilities.name: Holmsjön south spring
facilities.description: Official cold spring south of Holmsjön/after the Eskilstunavägen crossing, with matching OSM spring/drinking-water nodes nearby. Natural source: water availability/quality is not guaranteed; treat/filter. A 2024 blog found it flowing well, but that is not a guarantee.

facilities.name: Hellmanstorp/Eskilstunavägen winter parking caution
facilities.description: Small parking/access near the Hellmanstorp road crossing; official notes warn it is often unusable after snow because plowed snow blocks access. Treat as conditional, not reliable winter parking.

facilities.name: Stora Fjällsjön 2026 burn/smoke warning
facilities.description: Active 2026 warning: conservation burning may affect smoke/access during weeks 18-44 when conditions fit. Strong smoke can occur on burn day and for days after; about 200 m of gravel-road trail may be staff-controlled and temporarily stopped during operations.

facilities.name: Stage 22 reserve rule context
facilities.description: Rosmossen, Holmsjöberg and Stora Fjällsjön reserve rules protect living/dead trees, shrubs, plants, fungi/lichens and wildlife; organized camps or competitions need permission. Do not collect reserve wood for fires, and do not add off-route Stora Fjällsjön/Botvidstäppan BBQ nodes as Stage 22 facilities.

facilities.name: Bruksdammen shelter
facilities.description: Shelter/rest node on the Bruksdammen island near the stage end and Bruksslingan. OSM and official coordinates differ by only a short distance.

facilities.name: Bruksdammen grill/fireplace
facilities.description: Grill/fireplace on the Bruksdammen island. Follow fire bans and local rules.

facilities.name: Bruksdammen accessible toilet
facilities.description: Accessible toilet on the Bruksdammen island; Bruksslingan notes the toilet is closed in winter. Accessibility applies to Bruksslingan/boardwalk access, not the full Stage 22.

facilities.name: Bruksdammen fishing pier
facilities.description: Fishing-pier/rest context on the island. Exact pier pin not separately verified, so marker stays with the Bruksdammen facility cluster; the pier does not mean free fishing.

facilities.name: Fishing-permit warning
facilities.description: Fishing is not part of allemansrätten in inland waters. Check local fishing rights or buy the required fishing card before using Bruksdammen or nearby lakes; a fishing pier does not mean free fishing.

facilities.name: Bruksslingan / Edströmsvallen access
facilities.description: Accessible 4 km Bruksslingan/start-access context near Edströmsvallen; the official loop includes a 1.3 m wide boardwalk to the island and is useful for parking/access toward the stage end.

facilities.name: Vaggande stenen
facilities.description: Rocking stone about 1 km before Hälleforsnäs. Coordinate comes from an official-page user comment; treat as approximate field-check marker.

facilities.name: Bruksskolan bus stop
facilities.description: Nearest regular town-bus context for the Bruksdammen/Hälleforsnäs end, about 1.7 km from the Stage 22 endpoint. Check live Sörmlandstrafiken departures.

facilities.name: Hälleforsnäs station
facilities.description: Rail/bus access via connector 22:1 from the stage end/Bruksdammen area; direct distance is just over 2 km from the main-stage endpoint, but it is official via the connector. Do not assume station-side food, toilet or water.

facilities.name: Coop Hälleforsnäs
facilities.description: Town grocery/resupply after the walkout from Bruksdammen/22:1. Check current opening hours.

facilities.name: Hälleforsnäs bruk restaurants/cafes
facilities.description: Bruket area has restaurant/cafe/pizza/bakery options such as Bruksrestaurangen and Femhundra Grader. Opening hours vary.

facilities.name: Bäckstugan B&B
facilities.description: Hiker-oriented B&B near Sörmlandsleden in Hälleforsnäs with kitchen/WC/shower; verify availability before relying on it.
